thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: SEV2 — Elevated 5xx and latency on /v1/generate in hosted-us-west-2. Window 2026-03-10T02:12Z → 2026-03-10T02:47Z. Auto-failover triggered to fallback model. Estimated impacted requests: ~15%. On-call: Lina paged.

Lina (eng-oncall): saw the pager, investigating now. initial signals: sudden spike in mempressure on node pool g4-1; lots of OOM kills then retries. toggled autoscale to +20% capacity to buy time.

Alex W: Lina — do we have customer-facing impact numbers? any large accounts hit?

Lina (eng-oncall): quick check: error-rate spike correlates w/ a burst from a small number of tenants behind a single routing rule (route: legacy-multi). Top 3 tenants by error count: corpA, corpB, test-fleet. I'll run a deeper query and handoff to Alex in 10.

Alex W: taking over for deeper triage. thanks Lina. Lina, please add notes to the incident doc.

incident-bot: NOTE: On-call handover recorded: Lina -> Alex W at 2026-03-10T02:25Z.

Maria K: as soon as we're stable lets get a postmortem scheduled. availability: Mon 03/15 15:00 or Tue 03/16 11:00 PT. who can own minutes?

Tony S: will own remediation tasks for runtime config. currently hypothesize root cause = memleak in kv-cache eviction path when request concurrency spikes. patch candidate ready for canary.

Sarah M: I'll draft the RCA once we have timeline + root cause confirmed. can someone paste the short timeline here?

Alex W: timeline (preliminary):
```
02:12Z - first 5xx spike alert
02:13-02:20Z - autoscaler triggers, nodes spin up
02:21Z - OOM on 2 nodes, controller restarts pods
02:24Z - retries amplify traffic, error rate peaks at 02:27Z
02:30Z - mitigation: route fallback to smaller model; error rate drops
02:47Z - incident declared resolved (traffic normalized)
```

Jamie (cust-success): heads up — Account teams asking. We should prepare a short status page update and an email to impacted customers. prefer to send a short note within 4 hours, detailed RCA in 72 hrs.

Ryan (product): agree with timeframe. Short status page entry should be concise, say: "Partial errors and increased latency for requests to /v1/generate in hosted-us-west-2 between 02:12Z and 02:47Z. Mitigation applied. Root cause under investigation. Full RCA forthcoming." Keep it non-technical.

Tony S: action list (assignments + ETA):
```
- Create postmortem doc and invite: Sarah M (owner) — due 2026-03-13 23:59PT
- Runtime patch canary + metrics: Tony S (owner) — canary by 2026-03-12 18:00PT
- Status page short update: Jamie (owner) — publish within 4h of thread
- Customer email draft: Jamie + Ryan (owners) — draft in 8h, send after legal/account review
- Update runbook (eviction path): Ops team (owner: Lina) — update by 2026-03-14
- Add synthetic test to catch mempressure: Eng-platform (Tony lead) — PR by 2026-03-20
```
Sarah M: I'll start the postmortem doc. I'll need logs from 02:10–02:50 (request traces + node OOM logs). Alex — can you attach the queries/output?

Alex W: attaching snippets in the incident doc and will paste top traces here in 20.

ops-bot: ACTION CREATED: #INC-4892 "Runtime eviction path investigation" assigned to Tony S. Priority: P1.

Jamie (cust-success): Draft for status page (proposed):
"Between 02:12 and 02:47 UTC on 2026-03-10, some customers experienced increased latency and request errors for the Hosted API in the us-west-2 region. We applied an automated mitigation and rolled traffic to a fallback model; service returned to normal by 02:47 UTC. We are investigating root cause and will publish a detailed RCA within 72 hours."

Ryan (product): LGTM. I'd add: "We do not believe customer data was exposed." — keep it explicit.

Jamie (cust-success): noted. I'll add that sentence.

Lina (eng-oncall): quick note for the postmortem: eviction logic in kv-cache didn't respect the new concurrency hint we rolled last quarter. under sustained concurrency bursts the cache grew beyond expected and GC didn't trigger in time. logs show fragmentation.

Tony S: patch will add an explicit eviction guarantee + guardrail counters. will run canary on a small subset of nodes and watch OOM, p99 latency, and 5xx.

Sarah M: assigning writers: Sarah M (RCA author), Alex W (technical appendix and logs), Tony S (remediation plan), Maria K (product impact summary). I'll open the doc and add owners.

Jamie (cust-success): communications plan: 1) Status page update now. 2) Targeted emails to impacted accounts w/ account manager name cc within 8h. 3) Full RCA posted to status page + shared with customers in 72h. 4) Follow-up sync with top 5 impacted accounts — schedule in next week.

Alex W: added preliminary logs + query results to the doc: large contiguous allocations shown in node logs starting 02:15Z. correlates with a sudden spike in parallel requests from route legacy-multi.

Maria K: Postmortem meeting: booked Tue 03/16 11:00 PT with eng, runtime, product, cs. Agenda: timeline, root cause, remediation plan, comms review, action assignment, follow-ups. Invite includes stakeholders.

Sarah M: and I'll circulate a pre-read with the timeline + proposed RCA sections 24h before meeting.

ops-bot: REMINDER: please tag the postmortem doc with severity and impact labels for tracking.

Jamie (cust-success): I'll publish the status page update now and ping account teams. publishing link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1805127890 (drafted).

Ryan (product): next steps for trust restoration: 1) public transparency (status page + RCA), 2) proactive outreach to top customers, 3) accelerate backfill tests that prevent recurrence, 4) offer post-incident review w/ accounts (optional).

Tony S: noted. I'll target the runtime patch rollout to Dedicated and Hosted canaries first, then schedule broader deploy after verification.

Lina (eng-oncall): closing note: we've captured mitigation artifacts and logs; cluster stable; moving to post-incident mode. thanks team.

Alex W: thanks everyone. I'll keep thread updated with any new findings.

Sarah M: marking action items in the doc. will follow up with calendar invite and pre-read.

Jamie (cust-success): email cadence: draft out in #templates, will coordinate legal review. will send initial pings to impacted customers within 4h. :email:

Tony S: quick ask — someone from infra please keep an eye on the autoscaler metrics for 48h. tagging ops lead.

Maria K: ops lead @Lina — can you ack?

Lina (eng-oncall): ack, will monitor and report metrics every 6h for 48h. posting snapshots to the doc. :mag:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation verified. moving to Post-Incident Review track.

Sarah M: next check-in: 2026-03-13 09:00 PT to confirm RCA draft ready. If anything blocks earlier, flag in this thread.

Jamie (cust-success): thanks team. I'll DM account owners and confirm outreach schedule.

Alex W: closing thread for live mitigation — keeping it open for postmortem follow-ups.

Ryan (product): thanks all. good job on the quick mitigation and clear owner assignments. :thumbsup:
